question: What will be the total TSA checkpoint passenger volumes during December 2026?

calls.reasoning: Dec 2024 = 77.38M and Dec 2025 = 77.42M (summed TSA daily data); the two years were flat in mid-December. Calendar shift (Thanksgiving Nov 26, so the post-Thanksgiving Monday falls in November) gives a 2025-level baseline of ~76.97M (weekday-aligned Dec 1-18 = 42.71M + date-based Dec 19-31 estimate ~34.3M). 2026 YoY: Sep -3.4%, Oct -2 to -2.5% vs 2025; November runs about -1% to +3% vs 2024 (the 2025 comparison is distorted by the shutdown and FAA cuts), with the week before Thanksgiving strong. ~3% domestic seat cuts for Thanksgiving through December because of record jet fuel, fares +17%, and TSA's Thanksgiving forecast (roughly flat) imply about -1%. Left tail from a possible shutdown starting Dec 12 (CR expires Dec 11) and winter storms. No monthly market exists (Kalshi has weekly TSA markets only; none found on Polymarket or Manifold).
calls.reference_class: Prior December TSA monthly totals (2024, 2025) adjusted for calendar alignment and recent YoY weekday-aligned growth

calls.reasoning: Dec 2025 TSA total = 77.42M (summed daily). Calendar-aligning (Dec 1 2026 Tue ~ Dec 2 2025 Tue post-Thanksgiving; Christmas Fri, NYE Thu) gives ~77.4M at flat YoY. 2026 trend modestly negative: summer -2.7%, Oct -1.3% weekday-aligned, Nov 1-19 +1% against a shutdown-depressed 2025 base, TSA Thanksgiving forecast 17.6M (~-1%). Record jet fuel, United/American December capacity cuts and Christmas fares up 20%+ argue for about -1.5% YoY => median ~76.2M. Left tail: possible federal shutdown from Dec 12 (Kalshi 25-44%) and winter storms. Market check: no market on the December monthly total; Kalshi only has weekly TSA check-in markets (KXTSAW), a different contract, so not used as an anchor.

calls.reference_class: December TSA monthly totals, prior-year December adjusted for weekday/holiday alignment and the recent YoY trend

calls.reasoning: Dec 2025 TSA total = 77.42M (Dec 2024 = 77.38M). Adjusting for calendar (Dec 2026 loses the post-Thanksgiving Monday; Christmas Fri vs Thu; weekday mix) gives a flat-YoY baseline of ~77.0M. Recent 2026 weeks run ~1-3% below 2025 (Oct -1 to -2%, early Nov -3%), and TSA projects ~17.6M for Thanksgiving week vs 18.1M aligned 2025. Fares are up 20-30% on record jet fuel. Applied ratio ~0.985, plus a small downward skew for a ~25-34% chance of a shutdown on Dec 12 (Kalshi/Polymarket) and a minor risk that Dec 31 data is not yet posted at resolution. No market on the December total was found; Kalshi runs only weekly TSA markets.
calls.reference_class: Past December TSA checkpoint totals (2024, 2025), calendar-adjusted and scaled by the current 2026/2025 YoY ratio
